items.title: 52986_Lawrence Brown oral history interview
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] And Al Hibbler. [INTERVIEWEE] Well, there again, Al with his affliction, it was hard for him to keep up... He's still in Teaneck, New Jersey, I hear.

ctx.x: fine. I don't know why she quit or why she changed over, but we never heard much more of Jean. She was originally from Buffalo, I think, and I don't know whether she just wanted to go home or whether she had some differences with the powers that be or what.

Well, there again, Al with his affliction, it was hard for him to keep up, and they would have really had to hire another person just to take care of Al, which he was such a good voice, that when he did leave or when he changed, he was able to hire another -- someone to take care of him. He did quite well. So I really don't know what happens in those cases. He's still in Teaneck, New Jersey, I hear. In fact, he came to L. A. not long ago for a stint at a little off club, but it wasn't too good, I hear.
